query_and_random_rng: numpy.random.default_rng(repeat_seed), PCG64; fixed frame row order
retrieved_translation_assignment: Gemma make_plan orders by descending rendered input token count, then corpus and row ID. EXAONE make_plan preserves reference_full_plan source groups; model-specific token lengths and seeds remain distinct.
random_translation_assignment: plan sorts random-only sources by Gemma primary rendered token length descending, corpus and row ID. Both receive that order in up-to32 groups. EXAONE split_plan retains first16 groups/512rows and splits each subsequent group into up-to16; each half retains its parent greedy batch seed.
annotation_assignment: EXAONE annotation uses the original generator make_plan length/ID sort and token budget. Gemma uses persisted input order plus batch_schedule; exact per-branch plans remain in execution evidence. Do not infer a new row sharding scheme from GPU count.
final_random_training_worker_assignment: One model per worker, kcelectra or xlmr. cells(model) selects138 cells in repeat, translator, label order. Each cell contains its full frozen training frame, without splitting examples across classifier workers.
scope: Public numerical settings and assignment order; scientific settings are unchanged.
generation_seed_derivation: The original translation seed depends on a digest of original input texts, translator identity, and seed base. Original-text hashes and per-batch prompt hashes are not released here. The settings below alone do not constitute a complete generation replay.

native_sampling.rng: numpy.random.default_rng(seed), PCG64; preserve the cleaned training frame row order before sampling.

annotation_instruction_development.use: Earlier native-text assessment used to develop the annotation instruction; excluded from every classifier-training sample and the final assessment.

native_training.use: Fixed 200-example samples used for classifier training and retrieval; retained unchanged when the final assessment was later sampled.

superseded_assessment.use: Replaced before predictions after a pre-contract label-file alignment check; no assessment metrics were computed on this sample.

final_assessment.use: Separate 500-per-grade native-text assessment supplying the reported EXAONE scores; disjoint from development, all fixed training/query IDs and the superseded assessment.
